items.title: Gree Lomo-Eco 1.5 Ton Dual Inverter Smart AC (GP-18LM)
items.shortDescription: Original Gree 1.5 Ton Dual Inverter T3 Tropical Air Conditioner with Golden Fin anti-corrosion condenser and 65% energy saving.
items.description:
The Gree Lomo-Eco 1.5 Ton Dual Inverter Smart AC features high-end T3 Tropical compressor technology built for extreme summer heat up to 54°C. Equipped with 100% pure grooved copper tubing, Golden Fin hydrophilic condenser coating, and whisper-silent 21dB operation, this AC provides rapid cooling while cutting electrical bills by up to 65%.

  • Capacity: 18,000 BTU/h (1.5 Ton)
  • Energy Efficiency: 3.45 W/W EER
  • Refrigerant: Eco-friendly R32 Green Gas
  • Warranty: 10 Years Compressor Replacement Guarantee
  • Installation: Free Standard Factory Installation Included

specifications.value: 10 Years Compressor, 1 Year Parts, 1 Year Free Service

The legendary General (Fujitsu) 2.0 Ton Heavy Duty Inverter AC is engineered in Japan for peak reliability in hot tropical climates. Powered by a reinforced Hyper Tropical Twin Rotary compressor, it guarantees uninterrupted, ice-cold cooling even in scorching 58°C heatwave conditions.
